postconditions.expression: all(d_i + p[t % (2 * k)] <= l for t in range(2 * k * max(n, k)) for d_i in d)
postconditions.description: At any time t, the depth at any position i from the shore does not exceed l.
Koa's position x does not exceed the number of meters of sea n.
Time t starts from 0 and increases by 1 each second.

invariants.description: The depth at each meter of sea is non-negative.
The tide intensity k is at least 1.
The maximum allowable depth l is at least 1.
